result_note: QUALIFIED under the conditions below. The cause of attempt 1 is probable (a weak DRAM cell), not demonstrated: no divergent byte was captured.
source_records_note: local working notes, not published; this JSON is the published qualification record

criteria_fixed_before_the_tests.y_cruncher: version and configuration fixed before the run, an explicit list of components, at least 4 effective hours with every component completing a cycle, zero verification errors, hangs or unexpected restarts

attempts.configuration: qualificacao-refute.cfg: StressTest, AllocateLocally true, logical cores 0-31, 41768774400 bytes, 120 s per test, 15000 s in total, StopOnError true, tests BKT, BBP, SFTv4, SNT, SVT, FFTv4, N63, VT3
attempts.observation: one verification error in N63 on logical core 8 (ConvolutionFailedException: Coefficient is too large); no hardware event in the Windows log

attempts.configuration: N63 alone, 32 threads, 43.5 GiB, 120 s per test, 3600 s in total, Stop on Error off
attempts.result: 29 of 29 iterations passed; it does not cancel the FAIL and does not identify the component

attempts.configuration: 4 passes, about 12 hours, memory at 2666 MHz and 1.20 V (the daily configuration)
attempts.result: accepted under a criterion changed after seeing the result
attempts.observation: tests 0 to 10 without errors; test 13 (Hammer) failed in the 4 passes: 26 errors, all at the physical address 0x8C7CBD968 (about 35 GiB) and in the same bit, always from 1 to 0, also at the slow rate
attempts.criterion_changed_after_seeing_the_resul: The run is accepted because tests 0 to 10 had no errors and every error of test 13 was confined to a single address, whose page is excluded. Reason: the exclusion holds only inside Windows, and MemTest86 runs outside it. Under the criterion written before the tests (zero errors), this run would have been a FAIL.

attempts.action: the physical page 0x8C7CBD (4 KiB) excluded from use by Windows (BCD badmemorylist); no module removed or replaced

attempts.configuration: configured by hand (the program did not find the .cfg file): 32 logical cores, 45.8 GiB (1.43 GiB per thread), NUMA local, 120 s per test, 15000 s in total, Stop on Error on, the 8 tests
attempts.observation: 15 complete cycles (iterations 0 to 14) with the 8 tests passed; iteration 15 ended by the 15000 s limit; zero errors, no hang and no restart

residual_risk: The module is still defective and may have other weak cells that were not detected; the exclusion holds only while the memory configuration and the BCD do not change. The protections of the study (K = 3 in generation, two slots in analysis) turn an error of this kind into a block, not into an accepted result.
invalidated_if: any later test shows an error at another address
